newsitem.title: UK: Statistical changes cut UK government deficit - ONS.
newsitem.headline: Statistical changes cut UK government deficit - ONS.

text.p: Changes to accounting over public sector debt laid down by the European Commission will have the effect of cutting Britain's public deficit figures of the past two years, the Office for National Statistics said on Friday.
The ONS said the changes effectively reduce the UK's general government financial deficit to 5.0 percent of GDP in 1995/96, from 5.1 previously, and to 5.6 percent for 1995, from 5.8.

The EC has decided to account for writing-off debts of public corporations as a financial transaction within the privatisation process. Previously they counted as capital transfers which added to government debt.
